purpose: Policy authority for backend AllowAny endpoints. New AllowAny usage must be explicitly reviewed and documented here.

entries.rationale: Public health endpoint needed for uptime probes.
Public wizard must load fee/public config before auth.
Public family checklist status endpoint for in-progress admissions applications.
controls: Checklist key or application-id access requirement
Fail-closed non-disclosure on missing/unauthorized checklist context

entries.rationale: Public family document upload endpoint tied to admissions checklist workflow.
controls: Checklist scope resolution before item lookup
File presence/type metadata validation and scoped item ownership checks
Fail-closed non-disclosure and no broad admin/school data exposure

entries.rationale: Permit a prospective family to submit a short inquiry before authentication or creation of an application. Only POST is public; GET requires authentication and admissions.view in the requested school.
controls: Resolve one active school by UUID or an exact unambiguous campus name; reject conflicting or invalid school headers; tenant middleware exemption is POST-only for these exact paths.
Require explicit response_consent; record separate optional follow_up_consent and consent timestamp; bound request body and text fields; reject honeypot submissions and invalid contact formats.
Apply school-scoped IP and email rate limits with HMAC cache keys and fail closed on unavailable rate protection.
Persist school-scoped random-request-key idempotency and a payload digest; reject changed-payload replays; never reuse or disclose an existing family based on an unverified email match.
Return a no-store minimal receipt and a signed school/inquiry/nonce-bound continuation capability with a 30-day maximum lifetime and stored expiry; no public contact lookup or duplicate suggestions.

entries.rationale: Allow the holder of a captured inquiry's capability to record the actual start of an application before account creation; this does not provide public access by inquiry ID alone.
controls: Resolve one active school and reject invalid or conflicting school scope; the tenant middleware exemption applies only to POST on the exact continuation path.

Require a timestamp-signed school/inquiry/nonce-bound capability in the request body, verify its signature and 30-day age, and verify the stored nonce and unexpired school-scoped inquiry under a row lock.
Apply the request-body limit and school-scoped IP rate protection; return a generic unavailable response for a missing, invalid, expired, revoked, or wrong-school capability.
Record the start timestamp and touchpoint once; return only no-store school/inquiry/stage/expiry metadata, without family contact details, application data, or lookup by email.

Continuation references the consent-bearing capture record and does not grant or change contact consent; subsequent application submission must revalidate the same capability and replay its restricted stored receipt without creating duplicate household or child applications.
